name: docuqueue
description: Generate PDFs from templates using natural language. Create invoices, contracts, certificates, and more with AI.
long_description:
DocuQueue MCP Server connects your AI assistant to professional document generation. Browse templates, fill forms, generate PDFs, and batch-process documents — all from natural language.

Features:
- Generate PDFs from any DocuQueue template
- Fill IRS forms (W-9, W-4, I-9) automatically
- Batch-generate hundreds of documents
- Search and browse your template library
- Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP client
